div.div: مُنَجَّدٌ , as also مُنَجَّذٌ, (S, L,) which latter is the more approved, (L,) A man tried and strengthened by experience; expert, or experienced; (S, L, K;) who has had experience in affairs, and has estimated and understood them, and become well informed. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
